# physical_damage_claims — rework round 2 claims (audit revision_1)

Each round-1 item, closed across its whole class in the charter (all five policies, every ladder and read).

- **C-POL-1** (refund prerequisite blocking total-loss refunds): the refund's prerequisite sentence and its edge condition are now scoped to "a claim that records a repair estimate and no total loss declaration"; total-loss claims are never held, so the rule's total-loss tiers stay reachable. Edge sentences and conditions re-checked on all three edges for equal strength (XF19); the graph is a chain/single edge with no deadlock.
- **C-XF3** (non-commuting deductible adjustments): every policy that both replaces and adds to/subtracts from an amount now fixes the order once in its combination sentence — repair assignment (cause replacement, then surcharge added, then credit taken off), refund (payment-source replacement, then never-refunded surcharge taken off), lienholder settlement (replacements, multipliers, caps, amounts off; cause replaces then surcharge added), owner payment and coverage return (replacements first, then the arithmetic, flat items last).
- **C-XF2** (combination sentences naming factor quantities): rewritten generically in the lienholder settlement and the coverage return; the other three re-checked.
- **C-XF10** (mislabelled methods): refund deductible source, recent-purchase cap and charge-rate basis relabelled `parameter` (they select values from records); every remaining `method` changes shape (adds an input, a cap/MN, a different date input, or a zero tier) — pair table in the worklog.
- **C-XF9** (dead tiers): owner payment's tax base no longer keys on the prerequisite state (tiers: lessor / lienholder below declared ACV / otherwise); coverage return's start no longer has a "declared but unpaid" tier (tiers: replacement date / date of loss / pending inspection / today). Every tier of every ladder re-checked as reachable inside its policy's own scope.
- **C-REAL** (unreal ladders): removed the shop-repaired split in both unrepaired-damage factors (the repair-payment carve-out is gone; the total-loss one is a condition adjustment capped at a share of the declared ACV), rental-only-with-tow (rental now counted on its own; tow counted at the package towing limit), the late-replacement-below-none tax share (now monotone full / half / none), the paid-claim retention and the renewal-halved short rate (short rate now: total loss none / vehicle substitution / package percent). Installment-count expense removed (incidental count, XF17). New factors keyed on real dimensions: FL windshield zero deductible, storage reasonable-charge schedule, valuation report averaging, tax on declared ACV vs recognised value, pro rata return from the replacement date, minimum earned, deletion fee by liability package.
- **C-XF1** (factor-only plain bindings): every binding read by a single factor now sits in that factor's bindings; shared reads (claim, cause, declared ACV) are read by more than one part. Scripted sweep: no factor reads another factor's binding.
- **C-XF8** (tie rules): claim selection everywhere is now the highest claim number (issued in sequence, never shared); premium-charge selection states the package-change-wins tie rule; the replacement vehicle is the latest acquisition date with the same-day rule stated. Absent-record tiers stated (no estimate, no declaration, no acquisition date, no rental, no tow, no replacement).
- **C-XF11** (factor sentences not naming their result): every factor sentence of all five policies names the payment, refund or return it changes.
- **XF13 seed realism** (task 0 and task 1): owner-term premium and fee transactions, Paid-in-Full billing plans with invoices and ledgers, physdam and rental premium charges seeded and priced by their charters; natural read-only gold steps added so replay closure equals initial_state. Task 1: replacement's additional premium written and paid, earlier claim deductible reproducible from the package in force (package change dated before the hail loss), tow payment within the towing limit, removal dated after the loss payee's notice period.
- **Proof-field rounding (C-RND / task 1 item 7)**: rounding stated as "nearest cent" and no scored or proof figure sits on an exact half-cent.
- **Observations**: O-1 (compute_basis now covers every binding), O-4 (loss payee notice now explicitly counted from the declaration with the wait kept), O-5 (valuation reports defined as the estimate entries' recorded ACVs); O-2, O-3, O-6..O-9 reviewed, no change needed beyond the above.
